text:
maya: Quick sync: launching 'Takeoff' next week. Need final on launch posts, webinar, credits, prompt templates, and inbound routing.
noah: timeline?
maya: Launch post Mon AM, webinar Tue 11am PT, credits drip Wed for attendees.
sam: KPI? first-5-requests activation vs D7 retention?
olivia: primary = activation (first 5 within 24h). secondary = D7. baseline activation 22%.
rachel: social creative: 2 short prompts inline, CTA -> free $20 credits. keep copy punchy.
noah: routing rules: when do leads go to SDRs?
maya: route to SDRs if company_size>50 OR mentions security/private OR asks for dedicated. rest go self-serve + nurture.
ops-bot: note: adding routing rule: if company_size>50 OR form_interest contains "private" OR "dedicated" then route -> sales-sdr.
sam: landing idea: include a 3-template promptpack (support, summarizer, code helper) so people can hit first 5 quickly.
olivia: landing header options for A/B: A) "Launch with templates + $20 free" B) "Try Redwood inference with instant templates" — 50/50 split.
rachel: webinar plan: 10m product tour, 20m live prompt workshop, 15m Q&A. incentive: extra $10 credits if attendee completes first 3 requests live.
maya: finance/legal ok with promo?
noah: finance approved promo pool up to $5k, per-account cap $50.
ops-bot: created promo bucket "takeoff-webinar-2026"; webhook endpoint /promo/claim ready.
sam: analytics: track event template_run with fields template_id, tokens, success. use that to compare template vs blank-start activation.
olivia: also add event signup_source and experiment_variant for landing header.
maya: ops: ensure webhook auto-issues credits and enforces per-account cap. ops-bot can you add idempotency to claim flow?
ops-bot: claim flow includes idempotency key param, rate limits applied.
rachel: social post copy draft: "Start building with Redwood: 3 starter templates + $20 credit. See live demo Tue 11am PT. Sign up -> run 3 requests -> earn extra $10."
sam: I'll seed the template examples and wire the template_run telemetry to metrics dashboard.
maya: experiment notes: 1) landing header A/B 50/50. 2) sdr_probe = 10% of low-fit leads routed to SDRs to measure conversion lift. 3) monitor cost of extra credits vs delta in activation.
noah: I'll update routing-service with rules and the SDR handoff doc.
olivia: QA checklist: signup -> claim webhook -> auto-credit -> run template -> template_run event -> show credits consumed. test webhooks and idempotency.
maya: publish checklist: social post, blog with benchmark narrative (compare to baseline cohort), webinar page, promo bucket, routing rule, promptpack, analytics dashboard widgets.
rachel: publishing timeline: copy ready EOD, visuals by tomorrow morning.
sam: eval baseline prep done; will run comparison after first 48h.
maya: perfect. I'll post a recap and attach tickets. :rocket:
